sourceReview.focusVisible: Import setup calls addWindowFocusTracking; patches HTMLElement.prototype.focus and installs document/window listeners. Preserve this module.
sourceReview.hover: useHover registers global touch listeners via owned onSettled(setupGlobalTouchEvents), not import-time registration.
sourceReview.focusScope: Context/tree allocations at module scope; focus containment/restoration listeners belong to mounted scopes, not import-time setup.
sourceReview.metadata: Source sideEffects:false/CSS patterns are evidence only, not proof. Unknown expressions retain their exact module.
sourceReview.limitations: Reference syntactic census skips function bodies; immediately invoked function bodies/defaults require separate review and remain conservatively retained. No runtime execution or full purity proof.
